notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least four.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Nyx Lotus.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.
